Here is the corrected `.fd` source (the earlier attempt mistakenly put the Markdown embed *into* the `.fd` file instead of writing an actual FigDown document). This is the fixed `figures/cert-renewal.fd`:

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 block
title "Certificate renewal automation"

block scheduler "Scheduler"
block renewaljob "Renewal Job"
block caclient "CA Client"
block ca "Certificate Authority"
block deployagent "Deploy Agent"
block service "Service"

edge scheduler renewaljob "timer trigger"
edge renewaljob caclient "obtain certificate"
edge caclient ca "request new cert"
edge renewaljob deployagent "hand off cert"
edge deployagent service "restart"
```

Embed it in the host Markdown document as usual, separate from the `.fd`:

```markdown
![Certificate renewal automation: a scheduler triggers a renewal job, which obtains a new certificate via a CA client from the certificate authority, then hands off to a deploy agent that restarts the service.](figures/cert-renewal.svg)

<sub>source: [figures/cert-renewal.fd](figures/cert-renewal.fd)</sub>
```

Notes:
- The prior error came from writing the Markdown embed (image tag + `<sub>` footer) as the *content* of the `.fd` file. A `.fd` file must start with the spec-provenance comment line, then `figdown 0.1 block`, then genre content — never Markdown/HTML.
- All six required ids (`scheduler`, `renewaljob`, `caclient`, `ca`, `deployagent`, `service`) are declared as blocks, and all five described connections are present as edges, each with a short label rather than restating the whole narrative (per the "keep labels short" guidance for figure+prose mode).
- Next step: run `node <skill-dir>/build-svg.js figures/cert-renewal.fd`, fix anything the validator flags (block/edge keyword spelling is my best-effort reconstruction absent `reference/scene.md` in this context — if the validator names a different keyword, that error message is authoritative and should be followed over this guess), then look at the rendered SVG before committing both files.
